name: Chen Xuan
role: Our hero. Calm, lazy-looking operations supervisor at Hengxin Logistics who leaves at 4:55.

later.role: Heads home after his uncle's arrest. Secretly the Boss of the Black Pine Guard.
Wakes the Zero Guard with the Absolute Order after the red paint reaches his door.
Stands the Zero Guard down and gives command back to Number One.

name: Hu Dewei
role: Department manager at Hengxin Logistics. Carries a huge mug and loves to scold.

later.role: Tastes Chen Xuan's tea, goes pale, and offers him the desk by the window.

name: Pan Xiulan
role: Chatty coworker who praises whoever seems to be winning, then switches sides.

later.role: Smells Chen Xuan's tea and shrieks that it is Cloud Peak, 80,000 yuan a jin.

name: Zhang Pengfei
role: Coworker in a pressed suit who brags about his late nights and dislikes Chen Xuan.

later.role: Loses first place to Chen Xuan by 0.2 points and shows off a 9,800 yuan watch.
His initials are on the port invoice. He loses the recount and borrows a hotel card.

name: Sun Haoran
role: General Manager of Hengxin Logistics. Has just shouted at everyone all afternoon.

later.role: Comes to the recount, buys Chen Xuan's tea, and treats the floor to dinner.

name: Number Nine
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Man in a faded gray jacket on the bus, secretly watching Chen Xuan for Black Pine.

later.role: Shows the Black Pine Badge to Bao Zhen and orders a raid on Hongrui's street crew.
Watches the reservoir and quietly meets Ren Gang, who is guarding Zhao Dehai.

name: Number Seven
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Captain of the Black Pine watch team, in a windowless van painted like a flower truck.

later.role: Back in command after the Zero night. Plans the bread truck that saves Yu Changshun.

name: Liu Meifang
role: Chen Xuan's mother in Yunxi. Loud, worried, and always feeding him pork-rib soup.

name: Chen Mingde
role: Chen Xuan's Second Uncle. Gentle owner of a hardware shop on Old Street, arrested that afternoon.

later.role: Sits on a cold concrete bench but will not sign Hongrui's sale form.
Freed after forty hours. Director Mai bows and apologizes to him.
His shop is safe: owners now get the full 8,000 yuan per square meter.

name: Wu Lanying
role: Chen Mingde's wife. Shaken and crying after her husband's arrest.

later.role: Gets Dong Haisheng's threatening call. Chen Xuan holds her hand under the table.

name: Chen Jianguo
role: Chen Xuan's father. Proud and hot-tempered. Invents old sayings and pretends they are famous.

later.role: Slapped by Yan Tiehu on Old Street while defending his brother's wall.

name: Chen Hao
role: Chen Xuan's seventeen-year-old younger brother. Jokes to ease the family's fear.

name: Chen Yuan
role: Chen Xuan's sister. Quick, sharp-tongued, and the first to worry aloud.

later.role: A junior high teacher. Cheng Biao threatens her contract review.

name: Wang Lei
role: Old classmate who once paid Chen Xuan's meals for a month. Now drives a delivery tricycle.

name: Number Twenty-three
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Quiet owner of Gong's Noodles on Old Street. Secretly serves the Black Pine Guard.

later.role: Runs the county watch from his kitchen and keeps a clean bowl at an empty chair.
Counts the missing money: 190 million yuan of the relocation fund never reached families.

name: Yan Tiehu
role: Leads Hongrui's 'security team' on Old Street. Slaps Chen Jianguo, then gets slapped back.

later.role: Seized on the ring road by masked guards. Breaks down and names every dirty job.

name: Yu Changshun
role: Old tailor on Old Street. Stands in his doorway with a pressing iron during the fight.

later.role: Saw the 2:03 paint-shelf fall. Joins the thumbprint pledge at his shop.
Niu Dali offers 20,000 yuan to 'see nothing' and hints at harm to Yu Ning.
Writes and signs a statement on what he saw at 2:03.

name: Cheng Biao
role: Police officer at the station. Yan Tiehu says he drinks with him every week.

later.role: Deputy Director of county police who runs Old Street station. Bullies juniors and threatens families.
Takes 30,000 yuan from Hongrui per signature. Hopes to buy the police chief's chair.
Suspended from every post by Director Mai and led out of the station.

name: Number One
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Head of the Black Pine Guard. His is the only number on Chen Xuan's gray phone.

later.role: Obeys 'record, touch nothing'. Loses command when the Zero Guard walks into his study.
Tells General Qin the country is not going to war and to hold his missiles.
Offers Chen Xuan three options and carries out the one through the front door.

name: Wei Kun
role: Tired duty officer at Old Street station. Fancy title, no real power, still has a conscience.

later.role: Passes hot water through the bars to Chen Mingde and will not write a false hour.
Writes the true time, 7:50 a.m., on the detention notice.
Director Mai trusts him with the cell key after Cheng Biao falls.
Named Acting Deputy Chief of Old Street Station.

name: Lei Bo
role: Young officer who laughs at Cheng Biao's jokes one second early. Mocks complaints.

later.role: Squeezes Wei Kun for cigarette money and reports him to Cheng Biao.
Carries Cheng Biao's poisoned tea but the old records clerk spills it.
Pretends he hardly knows Cheng Biao once Director Mai arrives.

name: Zhou Pingan
role: Nineteen-year-old auxiliary officer at the door. Cheng Biao knocks his cap to the floor.

later.role: Quietly hands Wei Kun his fallen cap with both hands.

name: Number Thirty-four
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Round-shouldered records clerk at the station, secretly Black Pine, recording everything.

later.role: Files Wei Kun's true-hour notice and reports it with a smile.
Trips Lei Bo, spills the poisoned tea and keeps a sample as proof.

name: Number Forty-two
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Broad-shouldered night driver at the station, secretly Black Pine. Wants to flatten Cheng Biao's tires.

name: Fan Weiguo
role: County Party Secretary. Speaks softly, never shouts, and warns Cheng Biao before an inspection.

later.role: Finds masked figures and a black card in his office. All his power is frozen.
Takes Lu Wenzhe off the Old Street project in the committee meeting.
Waits for the inspection team, sleepless, hands shaking, still fixing his tie.

name: Tao Shu
role: County Magistrate who runs the county government. Skips a banquet with a 'cold'.

later.role: Stares at a black card on his desk while masked figures stand by his window.
Has waited eight years for Fan's chair. Keeps a gray folder on him.
Learns Pu Jian was taken. Orders that nobody ask about Chen Xuan again.

name: Lu Wenzhe
role: Executive Deputy Magistrate. Holds the county's money and takes a 'service fee'.

later.role: Named in the nineteen-page complaint. His suspension order is signed.
Removed from the Old Street project. His office records are sealed.

name: Dong Haisheng
role: Head of Hongrui Real Estate. Pays officials per signature to clear Old Street.

later.role: Panics when Yan Tiehu vanishes. Huang Boren orders him to clear the street.
Phones Wu Lanying to offer 228,000 yuan for the shop and threatens the family.
Caught at the fire plot against the clinic ledgers. His passport is taken.
Survives a heart-drug tea and calls the Discipline Commission on Huang Boren.

name: Gu Min
role: Aide to Lu Wenzhe who sits against the wall at the dinner and listens.

later.role: Warns Dong that Lu now denies ever visiting his office.
Now carries Tao's briefcase and is told never to ask about Chen Xuan.

name: The Zero Guard
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: A sealed second line on Chen Xuan's gray phone. He wakes it with the Absolute Order.

later.role: Masked, silent force above the Black Pine Guard. Only Chen Xuan can wake it.
Freezes the county and every leader. Each gets a matte-black card and a masked watcher.
Leaves, but one team stays near Chen Xuan. Black Pine may not approach it.

name: Niu Dali
role: Hongrui street man smoking at the corner while the neighbors whisper.

later.role: Calls round in panic when Yan Tiehu's van is found empty.
Runs the street crew now. Offers Yu Changshun 20,000 yuan and hints at his granddaughter.
Pinned to a brick wall in the Special Police raid.

name: Meng Xiaofang
role: Bun-stall owner on Old Street. Joins the thumbprint pledge despite her fear.

name: Han Guifu
role: Cobbler on Old Street who took over Master Sun's shoe stall forty years ago.

later.role: Throws an iron shoe last to defend Yu Changshun's sign.

name: Kuang Guihua
role: Vegetable seller. First told Chen Mingde to sign, then changed her mind after a threat.

name: Mai Zhenhua
role: Yunxi Police Director. Finds his SWAT squad disarmed under masked watch.

later.role: Freezes every police unit in the county inside its station.
Suspends Cheng Biao at the station at dawn.
Frees Chen Mingde and apologizes. A call from the province scares him.
Seizes the clinic ledgers and waits to see who comes to burn them.

name: Yao Xiaolong
role: Wiry Hongrui crewman. Waits at the barbecue stall for Yan Tiehu.

later.role: Smashes Yu Changshun's sign with an iron pipe. Hit by a flying shoe last.
Arrested in the raid; eats a hot dumpling in the back of a police van.

name: General Qin Zhengguo
role: Top serving four-star general. Masked guards stand silent on his command deck.

later.role: Told by Number One that the country is not going to war. Holds his missiles.

name: The retired Supreme Elder
role: Ninety-year-old retired elder in the western hills. Fears the masked force and will not name it.

name: Number Fifty-six
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Black Pine delivery rider. Watched the Zero Guard take Yan Tiehu and could not move.

name: Number Sixty-eight
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Woman at Gong's Noodles, secretly Black Pine. Says the guard grew careless around the Boss.

name: Huang Boren
role: Soft-voiced lender everyone calls Chairman Huang. Charges Dong Haisheng two percent a month.

later.role: Orders the clinic ledgers burned, then sends a man to sit with Dong.
Refuses Shen Jinbao's loan and sends a man to sit with him.
Sends a heart-drug tea to Dong Haisheng through his man Lian Cheng.

name: Su Min
role: Wei Kun's pregnant wife. Asks him each night whether he had a good day.

later.role: A free hospital bed waits for her after a 'chance' meeting with a nurse.

name: Zhong Hai
role: Wei Kun's desk partner of ten years. Afraid, and keeps his phone face down.

later.role: Leaks Wei Kun's true hour to Lei Bo for a 60,000 yuan loan.
Confesses to Wei Kun himself. Told to go sit with his son.

name: Yu Ning
role: Nine-year-old granddaughter of Yu Changshun. Stays at his shop on Saturdays.

later.role: Scraped her palm when a van crashed near her, then saw her grandfather's sign smashed.

name: Zhong Tiantian
role: Six-year-old son of Zhong Hai. Needs heart surgery that costs 80,000 yuan.

later.role: Has a fourth-floor hospital bed. Surgery is Thursday, paid by a charity fund.

name: Number Nineteen
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Deputy in the Black Pine van. Reads out the Boss's orders.

later.role: Second of the mobile unit. Reports that Number Fourteen oiled Chen Xuan's chair.

name: Number One Hundred and Four
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Man in a gray suit from the Black Pine legal desk, sitting at a tea stall.

later.role: Files the nineteen-page complaint at the Discipline Commission at 11:44 p.m.

name: Number Seventy-three
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Round-faced baker on the bread-truck team. His truck stops the gray van at the arch.

later.role: Sells buns at the county gate and sends Number One warnings from under his counter.

name: Bao Zhen
role: City Special Police team leader. Salutes the Black Pine Badge and raids Hongrui's crew.

name: Xie Boyuan
role: Hongrui's bookkeeper. Slipped away on foot when the crew was arrested.

later.role: Caught carrying kerosene to burn the ledgers. Blames Dong Haisheng at once.

name: Number Ninety-five
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Black Pine member who will help Wei Kun's pregnant wife get a proper hospital bed.

later.role: Under cover as head nurse. Meets Su Min and arranges a free bed.
Tests Lian Cheng's flask with a strip in the hotel clinic and saves Dong.

name: Qian Yu
role: Night clerk at the Municipal Discipline Commission. Stamps the complaint at 11:44 p.m.

name: Kang Guangming
role: Head of the Discipline Commission. Orders the complaint handled 'by the book. Nothing lost.'

later.role: Reads out that Lu's car sat behind Hongrui's office. Speaks for the first time.

name: Chen Fugen
role: Chen Xuan's grandfather. Loud, proud, fishes at a reservoir, and thinks Chen Xuan is too thin.

name: Zhao Dehai
role: Retired Governor of Lanshui, fishing as a quiet old man. Borrows ten yuan for worms.

later.role: Gives Chen Xuan a float with his seal. Phones Gao Zhengyi to move up the inspection.

name: Ren Gang
role: Colonel guarding Zhao Dehai with forty men. Sells cabbages as cover.

name: Liang Yuhang
role: Zhao Dehai's young aide. Swept the bank at dawn but missed the bakery van.

name: Gao Zhengyi
role: Provincial Vice Director. Jumps to attention when Retired Governor Zhao phones.

later.role: Leads the inspection team. Refuses the banner, fruit, banquet and Tao's tidy files.

name: Shao Wenhua
role: Head of the Organization Department. Has not spoken in nine straight meetings.

name: Zhou Guilan
role: Chen Xuan's grandmother. Lays a quilt over him and says he is too thin.

name: Ma Baoguo
role: Chief of the Housing Bureau. Called Lu Wenzhe 'Elder Brother' over drinks, now keeps his distance.

name: Pang Jinquan
role: Gate guard at the county compound. Buys buns from Number Seventy-three every morning.

name: Pu Jian
role: Provincial Organization Department officer. Opens Chen Xuan's file for Tao Shu and is taken away.

name: Ge Qinghe
role: Sixty-one-year-old Hengxin cleaner who gives Chen Xuan a warm tea egg.

later.role: Secretly Number Fourteen of the Black Pine Guard's Inner Ring, placed to watch over him.

name: Lin Dong
role: Youngest clerk on the twelfth floor. Works out the tea price on his phone.

name: Hao Jingshan
group: The Black Pine Guard (the hidden guard)
role: Tea-stall owner on Binjiang Road. Secretly serves the Boss, selling him rare tea for thirty yuan.

name: Qi Zihao
role: Wealthy young man with a Silver hotel card. Zhang Pengfei borrows it.

later.role: Shouts at the hotel when his card fails, then goes pale at Chen Xuan.

name: Qiu Guoqiang
role: Instructor of Old Street station. Back in charge, with Wei Kun as his deputy.

name: Dai Wenbin
role: General Manager of the Yunhai Grand Hotel. Runs to bow to the black 01 card.

name: Xia Mengyao
role: Young front-desk clerk who presses the red button. Chen Xuan protects her job.

name: Qi Jiancheng
role: Qi Zihao's father. Checks Chen Xuan's file and meets 'PERMISSION DENIED'.

name: Deng Weidong
role: Zhang Pengfei's wife's uncle at the Port Authority, whose stamp is on a disputed invoice.

name: Tang Xiaoyu
role: Thirteen-year-old girl who waits outside a noodle shop and claims her father works at Tiancheng.

later.role: Learns her father died at work, then stays with the Chen family.

name: Dong Yuzhen
role: Sixty-six-year-old Hongshi villager, loud and round, who shames Xinhe's district head.

name: Pei Daqing
role: Seventy-two-year-old Hongshi villager, stone-faced, who stares down liars and vows to end Tang Xiaoyu's lie.

name: Dong Weimin
role: Dong Yuzhen's grandson, who admits he moved the stake line to give her more room.

name: Xin Jun
role: Xinhe District head whose report claimed every ditch was concrete; Dong Yuzhen calls it false.

name: Shen Jinbao
role: Owner of Tiancheng Demolition who paid to hide a worker's death.

later.role: Faces inspectors; Huang Boren refuses his loan and sends a man to sit with him.

name: Peng Hu
role: Crew boss who took 600,000 yuan to bury a worker's death with a fake leave form.

later.role: Stopped on the expressway by highway police with 540,000 yuan in a sports bag.

name: Jiang Lixin
role: Provincial Labor Department night clerk who finds an anonymous new rule on the fax.

name: Xu Zhongping
role: Jiang Lixin's director, woken by a call, who asks him to read the rule again.

name: Cai Lan
role: Labor Inspection officer who serves the new rule on Tiancheng Demolition.

name: Gu Zhenyu
role: Labor Inspection officer who walks into Tiancheng with Cai Lan.

name: Rong Xiaomei
role: Fifty-four-year-old Tiancheng accountant who brings the real ledger to the lawyer.

name: Yin Hongwei
role: Yunxi Labor Bureau chief who carries the anonymous rule to the Party Secretary.

name: Hou Tianyou
role: Young clerk who asks which office issued the rule, then is told to write 'received'.

name: Lian Cheng
role: Huang Boren's mild man, who brings Dong Haisheng a steel flask of heart-drug tea.

name: Hua Qiang
role: Dong Haisheng's nine-year driver, who lets Lian Cheng upstairs and then confesses.

name: Ms. Ouyang
role: Civil Affairs officer who signs Tang Xiaoyu into the Chens' temporary guardianship.

name: Qin Yuhan
role: Haiyue group guest, twenty-eight, who reads Chen Xuan's file and asks to lunch with him.

name: Jin Ke
role: Qin Yuhan's assistant, who brings her Chen Xuan's file.
